sources_considered.why: Directly compares failures and successes in generalizing sentence meanings to unfamiliar structures.
Contemporary dialogue evaluations document improvements alongside remaining limitations.
Its benchmark successes were considered, but the selected records more directly address structural generalization and dialogue.

evidence_items.explanation: The comparison identifies a substantial weakness in sequence-to-sequence models while showing that other machine approaches succeed on the same structural tests. Neither result establishes general bidirectional language competence.

evidence_items.locator: Section 2, Related work, comparison with scaling studies
evidence_items.explanation: LaMDA's evaluations report improvements in dialogue quality, safety, and factual grounding, while retaining gaps from humans on some measures. This establishes progress without demonstrating the full language-acquisition goal.

unresolved_gaps: Neither study measures the full general language-acquisition capability described in the post.
The evidence does not establish a common success threshold for the broad collection of contemporary approaches.
